Europe Heatwave Causes Deaths, Disrupts Infrastructure, Sets Records

A severe heatwave has gripped Europe, leading to record-breaking temperatures across several countries, including Germany and France. The extreme weather has been linked to over 1,000 deaths in France and has caused significant disruptions, melting roads and buckling tram tracks. Experts are also noting alarming rates of ice melt on Swiss glaciers.
